verdict.rationale: Meltano is open source and self-hosted, so users keep their infrastructure on their own servers. The project is a plain code project whose plugins are defined in project files and kept under version control, and transformations use standard dbt, so there is little lock-in. This is portability by design rather than a documented export feature, and the hosted offering (docs-22) has no evidenced data-export or offboarding path. Missing for 10: an explicit documented export or offboarding capability, confirmation of open formats for exported data, a hosted-tier exit path, and independent hands-on corroboration of migrating away.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Own every part of your data infrastructure, on your own servers, free forever.

you can treat it like any other software development project and benefit from DataOps best practices such as version control, code review, and continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD)
